title: Listen, See and Track: Spatio-Temporal Audio-Visual Sound Event Reasoning for Omni-Modal Language Models
abstract: Understanding dynamic sound sources requires jointly determining what produces a sound, where the source is located, and how it moves over time. Yet existing audio-language models often represent clips as global acoustic events, while vision-language models lack the spatial audio cues needed to localize and track individual sources. To evaluate this missing capability, we introduce ST-OmniQA, a spatio-temporal audio-visual question-answering benchmark built from panoramic videos paired with synchronized first-order Ambisonics (FOA) audio of moving sound sources. It contains 40K videos and 400K question-answer pairs organized into four capability levels covering sound-event recognition, direction of arrival, source distance, motion trajectories, and temporally grounded audio-visual reasoning. Building on this benchmark, we propose ST-Omni-R1, which integrates FOA-derived semantic and trajectory representations with panoramic visual context and is trained through progressive curriculum learning and reasoning-tree reinforcement learning. ST-Omni-R1 achieves 77.83\% average semantic accuracy across the four levels, compared with 37.28\% for the best evaluated baseline. Results on three public spatial-audio benchmarks further indicate that its learned spatial and motion representations transfer beyond ST-OmniQA.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2608.09435v1 exact-version PDF 全文、文本抽取与页面渲染核验；代码状态按该版本 PDF 记录为 not-found，未发布 Code link。
analysis.ideaZh: 论文把 audio-visual understanding 从 event classification 推到“何时响、从哪里响、如何移动”的联合推理：ST-OmniQA 同时含 temporal localization、panoramic spatial grounding 与 motion tracking，ST-Omni-R1 用 focus-of-attention 表征和分阶段 SFT/RL 训练。作者报告主表平均 77.83，显著领先对比 omni-modal models，并在 real-world videos 上保持迁移。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它扩展 MLLM 对动态、多模态事件的空间时间 grounding，和具身场景中的听觉-视觉感知及 tracking 高度相关。
analysis.evidenceZh: ST-OmniQA 同时评测时间定位、全景方位与动态轨迹推理。（Dataset and task overview, pp. 2–3）；ST-Omni-R1 采用 focus-of-attention fusion 与三阶段训练。（Framework, Fig. 2, p. 4）；作者报告 ST-Omni-R1 在 ST-OmniQA 平均得分 77.83。（Table 2, p. 6）；模型在 real-world audio-visual evaluation 中仍优于 omni-modal baselines。（Table 3, p. 7）
analysis.caveatZh: 审阅风险：benchmark performance 不等同于开放世界声源定位可靠性，尤其是多源重叠和混响场景。；审阅风险：部分数据生成/标注结构可能让模型利用任务格式，而非真正联合音视频因果推理。
analysis.motivationZh: ST-OmniQA 将声音事件的时间段、360°视域方位和跨帧轨迹组织为多任务问答。ST-Omni-R1 先建立 audio/video token 的 focus-of-attention 交互，再以基础理解、spatio-temporal curriculum 和 reasoning-tree-guided RL 逐步训练，从单模态线索过渡到联合定位与跟踪。
analysis.methodZh: ST-OmniQA 将声音事件的时间段、360°视域方位和跨帧轨迹组织为多任务问答。ST-Omni-R1 先建立 audio/video token 的 focus-of-attention 交互，再以基础理解、spatio-temporal curriculum 和 reasoning-tree-guided RL 逐步训练，从单模态线索过渡到联合定位与跟踪。 核心贡献是把时间、全景空间和运动轨迹纳入同一 audio-visual reasoning benchmark，并用显式 curriculum 与 reasoning-tree reward 训练统一模型，而非只做声音来源分类或单帧定位。
analysis.experimentsZh: 比较 proprietary/open omni-modal language models，在 ST-OmniQA 多个 temporal/spatial/tracking subsets 及 real-world set 上评测；训练包含 SFT curriculum 与 RL，另做 component ablations。 作者报告：作者报告 ST-Omni-R1 主表平均 77.83，为所列模型最高。（Table 2, p. 6）；作者报告 real-world set 上训练方案仍带来稳定提升。（Table 3, p. 7） Baseline boundary：覆盖多种 omni-modal baselines 和三类 reasoning tasks；数据规模、语言/声学域与真实机器人 embodied settings 的覆盖仍有限。 Ablation boundary：分别分析 focus-of-attention、curriculum 与 reasoning-tree RL，支持 staged recipe 的增益来源。
analysis.insightZh: 核心贡献是把时间、全景空间和运动轨迹纳入同一 audio-visual reasoning benchmark，并用显式 curriculum 与 reasoning-tree reward 训练统一模型，而非只做声音来源分类或单帧定位。 新 benchmark 与训练框架直接推进 omni-modal spatio-temporal reasoning，证据足以精读；需保留真实复杂声场泛化边界。
